changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE pouvoir_profil DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_pouvoir_profil_portee;
ALTER TABLE pouvoir_profil ADD CONSTRAINT ck_pouvoir_profil_portee CHECK (portee IN ('AUCUNE', 'DIRECTS', 'EQUIPE', 'UNITES', 'TOUTES'));
ALTER TABLE pouvoir_profil DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_pouvoir_profil_portee_toutes;
ALTER TABLE pouvoir_profil ADD CONSTRAINT ck_pouvoir_profil_portee_toutes CHECK (portee <> 'TOUTES' OR action IN ('PROCESSUS_DEFINIR', 'PROCESSUS_LANCER'));
